Message.Name: Seconds Message
Message.Description: Sent every second for which at least one ITCH message is being generated. Contains the number of seconds since the start of 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC, also called Unix Time.

Message.Name: Order Book Directory
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Order book directory messages are disseminated for all active securities, including halted securities. Intra-day transmissions may occur when new order books are added or updates to existing order books occur.

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Denotes the primary identifier of an order book. Expired Order book IDs may be reused for new instruments.

Field.Name: Financial Product
Field.Description: Financial product type of the order book

Field.Name: Decimals In Price
Field.Description: Number of decimals used in price for this order book. A value of 256 means that the instrument is traded in fractions (each fraction is 1/256)

Field.Name: Decimals In Nominal Value
Field.Description: Number of decimals in Nominal Value

Field.Name: Odd Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of securities that represents an odd lot for the order book. A value of 0 indicates that this lot type is undefined for the order book

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the quantity that represents a round lot for the issue

Field.Name: Block Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of securities that represents a block lot for the order book. A value of 0 indicates that this lot type is undefined for the order book

Field.Name: Number Of Legs
Field.Description: Number of legs. Only applicable for combination instruments

Field.Name: Underlying Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book ID of underlying instrument. Only applicable for derivative instruments except for combinations

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Date of order expiration. Only applicable for derivative instruments. Valid format is YYYYMMDD

Field.Name: Decimals In Strike Price
Field.Description: Number of decimals used in Strike Price for this order book. Only applicable for derivative instruments

Field.Name: Put Or Call
Field.Description: Option type. A value of 0 indicates that Put or Call is undefined for the order book

Field.Name: Ranking Type
Field.Description: Specifies what ranking type should be used. 1 = Price Time

Message.Name: Combination Order Book Leg
Message.Description: Provides a mapping between a combination order book and one of the combination leg order books. One message is generated per leg that the combination consists of.

Field.Name: Combination Order Book Id
Field.Description: Denotes the primary identifier of the combination order book

Field.Name: Leg Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book ID of the leg instrument

Message.Name: Tick Size Table Entry
Message.Description: Contains information on a tick size for a price range. Together, all Tick Size messages with the same order book ID form a complete Tick Size Table.

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: The order book to which this entry belongs

Field.Name: Tick Size
Field.Description: Tick Size for the given price range

Field.Name: Price From
Field.Description: Start of price range for this entry

Field.Name: Price To
Field.Description: End of price range for this entry. Zero (0) means infinity

Message.Name: Short Sell Status
Message.Description: Indicates the short sell rules of an order book. Sent for order books which might have short sell allowing prior to the start of system. If an order book is absent from this message, clients should assume that the order book has no short selling rules at the start-of-day reference data messages. If short sell rules change during the day for an order book, this message will be re-sent for that order book.

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier. Only applicable for Equity Market instruments

Field.Name: Short Sale Restriction
Field.Description: Specifies Short Sell status and what Short Sell validation rule should be used

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: Used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: The system supports the following event codes on a daily basis

Message.Name: Order Book State Message
Message.Description: Relays information on order book state changes.

Message.Name: Add Order No MPID Attribution
Message.Description: Indicates that a new order has been accepted by the Genium INET Trading system and was added to the displayable book. Generated for unattributed orders. The message includes an Order ID that is unique per order book and side.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The identifier assigned to the new order. Only unique per order book and side

Field.Name: Ranking Sequence Number
Field.Description: Transaction-based and sequential number starting from 1. Used only in ranking logic with ranking time. Does not show order book position

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The visible quantity of the order. Orders with an undisclosed quantity will have this field set to 0

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order. If bit 31 is set (MIN_INT), this represents a market order

Field.Name: Order Attributes
Field.Description: Additional order attributes. Applicable types may be defined by the marketplace

Message.Name: Add Order With MPID Attribution
Message.Description: Note: This message is not used, it remains in the ITCH specification for future reference and is not applicable for BIST markets. Would be generated for attributed orders and quotations entered into the Genium INET Trading system.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The identifier assigned to the new order. Only unique per order book and side

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The visible quantity of the order. Orders with an undisclosed quantity will have this field set to 0

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order. If bit 31 is set (MIN_INT), this represents a market order

Field.Name: Order Attributes
Field.Description: Additional order attributes. This field is a bit map, multiple values may be set simultaneously. Applicable types may be defined by the marketplace

Field.Name: Participant Id
Field.Description: Market participant identifier associated with the entered order

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an order on the book is executed in whole or in part. Modify Order messages always include the Order ID, Order book ID and Side of the Add Order to which the update applies.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The order ID associated with the executed order

Field.Name: Match Id
Field.Description: Assigned by the system to each match executed

Field.Name: Combo Group Id
Field.Description: Used to group combination order book executions and the trades in the constituent order books together

Message.Name: Order Executed with Price Message
Message.Description: Sent in the relatively rare event that an order on the book is executed in whole or in part with a price different than the initial display price. Combination orders on the book that execute will always be represented by this message, with the Printable flag set to N; leg trades are published with the Trade message and are printable.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The order ID associated with the executed order

Field.Name: Match Id
Field.Description: Assigned by the system to each match executed

Field.Name: Combo Group Id
Field.Description: Used to group combination order book executions and the trades in the constituent order books together

Field.Name: Occurred at Cross
Field.Description: Whether the trade occurred at the cross

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the trade should be included in trade tickers and volume calculations

Message.Name: Order Replace Message
Message.Description: Note: This message is not used, it remains in the ITCH specification for future reference and is not applicable for BIST markets. A replace of an existing order would be represented by an Order Delete Message followed by an Order Add Message but the original order ID would remain. This message would be sent whenever an order on the book has been cancel-replaced. The Side and Order book ID remain the same as the original order.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The original order identifier of the order being replaced. Only unique per order book and side. Does not change when the order is replaced

Field.Name: New Order Book Position
Field.Description: New rank within order book. Superseded by ranking time/ranking sequence number logic; not shown in current ranking logic

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: New visible quantity of the order

Field.Name: Order Attributes
Field.Description: Additional order attributes. This field is a bit map, multiple values may be set simultaneously. Applicable types may be defined by the marketplace

Message.Name: Order Delete Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an order on the book is being deleted. There will be no remaining quantity, so the order should be removed from the book. Normally, no Order Delete message is sent when an order is completely filled.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The original order identifier of the order being deleted. Only unique per order book and side

Message.Name: Order Book Flush Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an order book is flushed. All remaining orders are no longer accessible and should be removed from the book. Markets by order dissemination may be disabled during auctions by configuration; in such cases every existing order of the order book is removed by this message immediately prior to the auction. Owners of these orders must not interpret this as order cancellations, and should use the private order flow to determine the state of their orders.

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: Designed to provide execution details for normal match events involving non-displayable order types. Also used to publish individual cross trades. Since no Add Order Message is generated when a non-displayed order is initially received, the Order Executed message cannot be used for all matches; the Trade Message reports a match for a non-displayable order in the book. Trade Messages should be included in trade tickers as well as volume and other market statistics.

Field.Name: Match Id
Field.Description: Assigned by the system to each match executed

Field.Name: Combo Group Id
Field.Description: Used to group combination order book executions and the trades in the constituent order books together

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Type of non-display order on the book being matched. Blank (space) for anonymous markets

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity being matched in this execution

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the trade should be included in trade tickers and volume calculations

Field.Name: Occurred at Cross
Field.Description: Whether the trade occurred at the cross

Message.Name: Equilibrium Price Update
Message.Description: Used when auctions occur. Provides the changes in equilibrium price. Markets by order dissemination may be disabled during auctions by configuration.

Field.Name: Available Bid Quantity at Equilibrium Price
Field.Description: Quantity at equilibrium price on the bid side

Field.Name: Available Ask Quantity at Equilibrium Price
Field.Description: Quantity at equilibrium price on the ask side

Field.Name: Equilibrium Price
Field.Description: Equilibrium Price. If bit 31 is set (MIN_INT) it means that no price is available

Bitfield.Name: Order Attributes
Bitfield.Description: Additional order attributes. Applicable types may be defined by the marketplace

Value.Name: No Restrictions
Value.Description: Short selling is allowed with no price validation

Value.Name: Short Selling Allowed With Up Tick Rule
